capabilities: switch directly to reading, source, or live preview mode
cycle through modes with a next-mode command
keep the existing source/preview setting when switching to edit
set a per-note default mode with the default-mode property
extras: README notes that the default-mode property is currently broken for daily notes opened on startup.
intentEvidence: rather than relying on the default toggle behaviour
problem: Obsidian only offers a toggle between edit and read modes, so jumping to a specific mode such as source or live preview takes multiple steps.
summary: Command set that switches directly to reading, source, or live preview mode and can set a per-note default mode via a property.
